completeness.why: Four sites now pass their raw value to the existing getScheduledAmount; the budget template only calls a new getRangedAmountMidpoint for the range arithmetic and keeps its own op === 'isbetween' dispatch, and its rounding-of-the-sum variant is dropped rather than selected by an explicit argument, so it is partial.

interface.why: Reusing getScheduledAmount and widening its type to accept null is right, but the extra getRangedAmountMidpoint export exists only for the template and the template's distinct rounding (halving the rounded sum) is silently removed instead of being carried as a named rounding option.

disguised_duplication.where: The four inlined ternaries are removed in favour of getScheduledAmount; the remaining template dispatch is an open partial, not a disguised copy.
